messages:
Priya R: Quick heads-up: final cutover window for Altair is Wed 08:00 PST. We need a green light on network, IAM roles, CMK, and audit forwarding by EOD Tue. Owning: @Jordan L (network), @Samir D (infra), @Iris K (security).
Jordan L: Network status: transit gateway attachment is in place. Customer confirmed 10.16.0.0/16. I've prepared route table changes and a small PR: https://git.internal/net-prs/altair-routes (will push diff tonight). Flow logs enabled -> s3://altair-flowlogs but bucket policy currently blocks cross-account writes.
Samir D: Infra checklist: cross-account role created (arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/Redwood-Altair-CrossRole). I'll create the CMK with rotation enabled and attach alias. Command I'll run: ```bash
aws kms create-key --description "Altair private CMK" --tags TagKey=customer,TagValue=altair
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id alias/altair-cmk
```
Iris K: Security items: drafted KMS key policy requires the cross-account role principal and our service principal. Also enabling multi-region CloudTrail and forwarding to their SIEM via SQS -> SIEM ingestion. Draft policy in CS-4120. One question: customer prefers 90d retention for logs; Legal tentative OK, but flag in renewal notes.
Priya R: Renewal risk: record that retention is 90d for now; if they request longer retention or EU-only storage later, this will become a contractual negotiation and could delay future cutovers. Capture in renewal doc.
Jordan L: Cost note: NAT gateway egress during cutover could be high. Proposal: during the 2-hour window, restrict NAT access to deployment subnets only, and rely on VPC endpoints for S3/KMS to avoid heavy egress. Will include estimated delta in PR.
Samir D: Pre-cutover smoke tests scheduled Tue 14:00 PST: small canary deploy to reserved pool + connectivity checks. Smoke test commands: ```bash
curl -s -D - https://api.redwood.internal/health | head -n 1
aws s3 ls s3://altair-flowlogs --profile altair-staging
```
ops-bot: calendar event created: "Altair private cutover - Wed 08:00 PST" invited: Priya R, Jordan L, Samir D, Iris K. ticket created: CS-4120 assigned to Iris K, Samir D
Iris K: Audit ingestion: They asked for S3 -> SQS notifications. I recommended S3 -> Kinesis -> SIEM for durability, but SQS is simpler. I'll send both options to the PM and mark the chosen option in CS-4120.
Priya R: Action items (summary): Jordan post route diff (EOD), Samir run smoke and create CMK (tomorrow), Iris finalize KMS policy + choose logs ingestion path (tomorrow). I'll run the cutover playbook and capture the retrospective notes 24h after.
Jordan L: No blockers from network.
Iris K: Waiting on customer to confirm IAM principal ARN for policy; pinged them.
Samir D: Adding a last-minute preflight: verify KMS decrypt from a host in the private subnet using our cross-account role. If that fails, rollback plan: hold cutover and revert routes.
Priya R: Thanks team. I'll also ask CS to capture quick NPS-style feedback after cutover (one question: "Was the cutover well-communicated and executed?") and log any enablement gaps. :thumbsup:
